title: False Cases
intro: If you or someone you know has been targeted with a false or fabricated case related to the July uprising, you can securely submit timestamped evidence here. Every submission is forensically checked, and only you and a verifying admin can see it.

private.title: Fully private
private.body: Your submission is never shown publicly — only you and a reviewing admin can see it.

forensic.title: Forensically checked
forensic.body: Every photo or document is screened for manipulation and duplicates, strengthening the credibility of your evidence.

track.title: Track its status
track.body: Log in to check your submission's review status at any time.

loginNote: Submitting evidence requires logging in with your email — no password needed.
loginRequiredDescription: You need to log in with your email before submitting evidence, so you can check its status later.
submitDescription: Fill in the accused person's details, the circumstances, and supporting evidence (image or document) below. Your evidence is analyzed automatically before submission.

form.description: Description of the incident and why this is a false case
form.duplicateWarningDescription: A similar file appears to have already been submitted. You can still submit — an admin will review it.
form.successDescription: Your evidence has been submitted and is awaiting admin review. We'll reach out using your provided contact details if needed.

errors.descriptionTooShort: Please add a bit more detail (at least 10 characters).
errors.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.notLoggedIn: Your session has expired. Please log in again.
errors.uploadFailed: File upload failed. Please try again.
errors.analysisFailed: Could not analyze the file. Try a different file.
